summary: The European Master in Law and Economics (EMLE) is an Erasmus Mundus LL.M. programme in law and economics run by a university consortium. Applications for the 2027/2028 edition opened on 1 September 2026. Non-European applicants apply by 31 December 2026 and European applicants by 15 January 2027. About 15 full Erasmus+ scholarships are available per academic year, awarded on merit.
highlights: Deadlines: 31 December 2026 for non-European applicants, 15 January 2027 for European applicants.
Only fully completed applications, including at least one letter of reference, are considered.
Scholarships are merit-based, ranked among complete, on-time applications.
Targeted scholarships encouraged for applicants from Sub-Saharan Africa and the Western Balkans.
Application status not yet confirmed: verify the dates and requirements on the official EMLE page, including the study locations, before applying.
